result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers choose B and give the same correct numbers for A (about 8px on a phone, about 42px on a large monitor). Both also cover C's fixed-px and abrupt-jump problems. Answer B edges ahead: it hedges more accurately on how zoom affects vw text, points out that only B controls line length, and gives a practical fix for C (use rem instead of px) plus a centering tip. Answer A's strong point is estimating the actual width of the 68ch cap. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers clearly pick B and explain the same problems with A (about 8px on phones, about 42px on large monitors, ignores user settings and zoom) and with C (px overrides the user's default size, abrupt jump at 1200px). Answer B is slightly stronger on the line-length item because it also gives the width the cap produces (about 700–750px at the max size) and notes that C would still need a max-width. Both are similarly concise, though B's optional tweaks add a little length.
